# Hoomi MicroApps SDK

## Quickstart

Import the SDK and call `getHoomi` after the host is ready.

## Wallet payloads (protocol v1)

Payment amounts use integer minor units.

## React

Use the React bindings inside the micro-app page.

## Developing without the superapp: the mock host

Use the mock host for local development.

## Testing your micro-app

Use the testing helpers to verify bridge calls.

## Error model

Bridge failures are returned as typed errors.

## Protocol notes

The SDK is a WebView bridge.
